title: Neutrophil Phenotypic Profiling and Acute Lung Injury in Patients After Cardiopulmonary Bypass (CPB)
official: Neutrophil Phenotypic Profiling and Acute Lung Injury in Patients After Cardiopulmonary Bypass (CPB)
summary: Acute lung injury (ALI) following cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB) is a serious complication, often prolonging the length of stay in ICU and potentially dealing to mortality. The objective of this study is to assess the mechanism of CPB-mediated acute lung injury in pediatric patients.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Are \< 12months of age
* Scheduled for cardiac surgical needing CPB
* Preoperative SpO2 \> 90%

Exclusion Criteria:

* Lack of parental (or legal guardian's) consent
* Preoperative SpO2 \< 90%
* Preoperative oxygen therapy
